notes: REF-BM-02: metadata.js only parses title/description; no favicon URL or og:image/preview-image extraction anywhere in the codebase (favLetter() in library.js just shows the hostname's first letter, not a real favicon). REF-BM-03: title/description are only editable after saving (openEditor); there is no pre-save review/edit step — save() fetches metadata and commits immediately. REF-BM-07: list cards show title/description/tags but no real favicon (same gap as REF-BM-02). REF-BM-14: no '#tag' search token is parsed anywhere in query.js/library.js — tag filtering only works via clicking chips in the topic bar (REF-BM-11), not through the search box. REF-BM-15: query.js parseTerms/matchesQuery only ANDs bare/quoted terms; there is no AND/OR/NOT operator or parenthesized-group grammar, so the literal-quoting rule is moot since operators aren't recognized at all. REF-BM-20: bulk actions cover add-label, later/read/drop, aside/back, delete, and copy-now, but there is no bulk 'remove tag' action as named in the requirement. REF-BM-23: notes are a sanitized contenteditable rich-text field (bold/list/paragraph/br only) rather than markdown source that is parsed/rendered — functionally similar but not markdown. REF-BM-24: captured 'snapshot' is a reader-mode content extraction (nav/header/footer/scripts stripped, only allow-listed tags kept) rather than a full single-file snapshot of the page as seen; the PDF-instead-of-HTML sub-rule is correctly implemented. REF-BM-32: settings only expose text size, theme, and a keep-copies toggle — no default-sort or displayed-items-per-page setting exists in settings.js/library.js.
